Title: Ship 42
Outlet: Next Spaceflight
URL: https://nextspaceflight.com/starship/hardware/80/

Ship 42 is a v3 Starship upper-stage. Ship 42 flew on Starship Flight 15, during which it became the first Ship to be caught by the tower.

Cryogenic Proof Test #3
Cryostation, Massey Outpost, Texas, USA
Fri Oct 9, 2026
Ship 42 conducted a cryogenic proof test to verify the structural integrity of the vehicle.

Cryogenic Proof Test #2
Cryostation, Massey Outpost, Texas, USA
Fri Sep 4, 2026
Ship 42 conducted a pair of cryogenic proof tests within the same window to verify the structural integrity of the vehicle.

Cryogenic Proof Test #1
Cryostation, Massey Outpost, Texas, USA
